mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 65 degrees with clear skies near Verona Area High School and we have a full moon tonight. Also, the International Space Station will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

For our city news, please be advised that Highway M will be closed for road construction from October 5 through October 7 to allow for asphalt work. Additionally, the city is warning residents about a scam involving fake emails requesting payment for planning or zoning fees, so please remember that the city only accepts payment by check.

There is plenty to do, including the Dane County Farmer's Market happening today, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's throughout the day. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on September 28 or trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee on September 29.

In our weekly police report, on September 5, officers encountered a strange situation where multiple vehicles had slices of cheese placed on their windshields, which was identified as a social media prank.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious OREO REESE'S Cheesecake and the restaurant is currently open for you until 10:30 PM.
